title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)… (CVE-2026-101209)
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows a high-privileged attacker with remote access to potentially cause information exposure. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 2.7, indicating limited impact. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported. No patch information is provided in the input data.
